title: Update Safety Valve Locking Mechanism
description: Add secondary mechanical locking feature to prevent valve actuation during vibration testing. Critical safety enhancement.
justification: Near-miss incident identified during high-vibration testing phase. Valve actuated unexpectedly.
time_impact_reason: New machining step required for locking feature
qa_review_notes: QA approves. New testing protocol defined.

title: Substitute Hydraulic Seal Material (Viton → EPDM)
description: Replace Viton O-ring seals with EPDM compound in hydraulic cylinder assemblies. Both materials meet operating pressure/temperature specs.
justification: Viton supplier lead time increased to 18 weeks. EPDM available from approved supplier with equivalent specification.
time_impact_reason: Minimal process change, different supplier procurement

title: Rail Bracket Weld Geometry Revision
description: Revise weld joint geometry on rear rail bracket assembly to eliminate stress concentrations. FEA shows 40% improvement in cycle life.
justification: Three prototype failures at weld toe during 50k cycle fatigue test. Root cause: notch effect at toe radius < 1mm.
time_impact_reason: New welding fixture required, setup and validation time

title: Introduce Jig Fixture for Axle Alignment
description: Design and introduce dedicated alignment jig to replace manual shimming process. Expected to reduce axle misalignment rejects from 8% to <1%.
justification: Ongoing reject rate of 8% at final inspection due to axle misalignment. Manual process is not repeatable.
time_impact_reason: New tooling design, build, and validation required

title: Update Paint Spec to 2-Pack Epoxy Primer
description: Update paint specification from single-pack primer to 2-pack epoxy system to meet new corrosion protection requirements.
justification: Customer issued updated corrosion spec COR-7 requiring salt spray >500h. Existing primer only achieves 280h.

title: Fastener Supplier Change: Switch to ProFast Ltd
description: Evaluate switching M12 Gr.8.8 fastener supply from Acme Fixings to ProFast Ltd for cost reduction (22% savings).
justification: ProFast quote is 22% lower. Samples appear visually identical to current supplier.
qa_review_notes: ProFast samples failed tensile testing. Acme remains approved supplier only.
